instruction.text: Lies den Text von Haruna und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: My parents and I have a very close relationship. My fathers have rather different interests which makes it easy for us to find something to do as a family. Often, we go hiking together or play board games at home. Sometimes, when I don't feel like spending time with them, my parents will give me the space I need. On these days, I prefer to meet up with friends or play my favourite video games.

atoms.a: What is the relationship between Haruna and his parents like?
b: distant, Haruna mostly needs his space
depends on the day, sometimes they fight

atoms.a: What does Haruna like to do on his own?

instruction.text: Sieh dir den E-Mail-Austausch zwischen Dana und Gustav an.

hint.text: Tippe den Lautsprecher unter dem Bild an, wenn du die E-Mail hören willst.

atoms.sound: Hey Gustav, Well, my family is quite chaotic. I have three brothers, so I am the only girl in the family. My parents are divorced and we all live with our dad. It's not always easy as a single parent of four so my little brother and I help our father a lot. Our young siblings are only three and six years old. If you want privacy, you really need to leave the house. Do you also have siblings? Best wishes, Dana

hint.text: Tippe den Lautsprecher unter dem Bild an, wenn du die E-Mail hören willst.

atoms.sound: Hi Dana. That sounds like trouble! Yes, I do have two brothers. We are a typical patchwork family. My mum married my father who has already had a son. He is 15 years older than me. My younger brother is two years younger than me. I love our family. Sometimes, we visit our mother's friends Mona and Mila with her. Then we mostly take her of Mona's horses. That's always so fun! Best, Gustav

instruction.text: Beantworte die Frage, indem du die richtige Antwort auswählst.

atoms.a: Which person lives in a patchwork family?
Who feels like there is only little privacy at their home?
Which person enjoys visiting their parent's friends?
